title: Escaping Path Mirages in Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.40130v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning remains challenging in stochastic long-horizon settings, where compounding value estimation errors hinder reliable goal reaching. While prior methods have sought to address this challenge through various approaches, a key challenge remains path mirage, where agents overcommit to spuriously successful trajectories in offline datasets induced by stochasticity, often leading to failure on difficult tasks. To address this issue, we propose Branch-aware Graph Planning (BGP), which captures stochastic branching structures by identifying high-variability points as graph nodes and designing goal-conditioned edges with segmented learning to avoid unreliable branches and reduce unnecessary stochasticity along paths. translated_title: 在离线目标条件强化学习中逃离路径幻象
translated_abstract: 离线目标条件强化学习在随机性长时程环境中仍然充满挑战，因为不断累积的价值估计误差会阻碍可靠的目标达成。尽管先前的方法已经尝试通过多种途径应对这一挑战，但一个关键问题依然存在——路径幻象，即智能体过度依赖离线数据集中由随机性导致的虚假成功轨迹，这往往造成在困难任务上的失败。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了分支感知图规划（BGP），该方法通过将高变异性点识别为图节点来捕捉随机分支结构，并设计结合分段学习的目标条件边，以避开不可靠的分支并减少路径上不必要的随机性。因此，即使在高随机性的长时程环境中，BGP 也能实现可靠的目标达成。在多样化 OGBench 任务上的实验表明，其性能显著优于先前的方法。
tldr: 提出分支感知图规划（BGP），通过将高变异性点识别为图节点并设计分段学习的目标条件边来捕捉随机分支结构、避开不可靠分支，从而在高度随机的长时程离线目标条件强化学习环境中实现可靠的目标达成。
en_tdlr: Proposes Branch-aware Graph Planning (BGP), which captures stochastic branching structures by identifying high-variability points as graph nodes and designing segmented goal-conditioned edges, avoiding unreliable branches to achieve reliable goal reaching in highly stochastic long-horizon offline goal-conditioned RL.
